function.uniprot_function: Casein kinase I isoform alpha is a serine/threonine protein kinase that regulates signal transduction and several core cellular processes. Functions in the Wnt signaling axis as part of the beta-catenin destruction complex. Phosphorylates CTNNB1 at Ser-45, priming it for subsequent sequential phosphorylation by GSK3A/GSK3B at Thr-41, Ser-37, and Ser-33, leading to ubiquitination by BTRC and proteasomal degradation. Also functions in circadian rhythm regulation by phosphorylating PER1 and PER2, stimulating their degradation and modulating circadian period length. Plays roles in p53-MDM2 regulation through phosphorylation cascades, nucleo-cytoplasmic shuttling of transcription factors, DNA repair, and DNA transcription. Substrate specificity: preferentially phosphorylates serine/threonine residues in canonical motif pS/T-X(n=2-4)-pS/T or noncanonical motif pS/T-X-pS/T, indicating preference for primed substrates.

pathways.pathway_role_summary: CSNK1A1 is a critical negative regulator of Wnt/beta-catenin signaling through its role in the beta-catenin destruction complex, where it initiates the phosphorylation cascade leading to beta-catenin degradation. It also regulates circadian rhythm by phosphorylating PER proteins to control their degradation and modulate circadian period length. Additionally involved in p53 regulation, cell cycle control, and mTOR signaling.

disease_associations.description: CSNK1A1 is located in the common deleted region for del(5q) MDS. Haploinsufficient expression sensitizes cells to lenalidomide therapy, which induces CRBN-mediated degradation of remaining CK1alpha protein.

metadata.data_quality_notes: High-quality data available for core kinase domain structure and Wnt signaling interactions. Limited quantitative kinetic data available for most protein-protein interactions (only Km ~100 nM for beta-catenin phosphorylation found). Specific residues for autophosphorylation sites and some PTMs not fully mapped. Alternative splice variant sequences incomplete in public databases. Good structural coverage with multiple PDB structures and AlphaFold prediction.
metadata.modeling_relevance_summary: CSNK1A1 is essential for modeling canonical Wnt signaling as it initiates the beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade in the destruction complex. Its enzymatic activity (Km ~100 nM for beta-catenin) makes it a key control point for beta-catenin stability and downstream transcriptional responses. Also critical for circadian rhythm models involving PER/CRY dynamics. Autophosphorylation-mediated regulation of substrate specificity adds complexity to kinetic modeling.
